The main takeaway from our work is that
PINK1/PARKIN-mediated selective autophagy and non-apoptotic cell death are two independent processes that are triggered by mitochondrial damage.
PINK1 is not only a regulator of mitochondrial autophagosome formation, but also a regulator of non-apoptotic cell death.
